purpose: Five original cute cartoon carpet designs explicitly requested by the user for Refluff
rights_note: Original generated artwork; not represented as museum open-access, public-domain or CC0 material.
integration: Textures/Resources/CarpetPictures; merged with the serialized CarpetHandover.pictures list at runtime.
processing: Copied unchanged from the built-in tool output. Native dimensions retained; PictureFit covers the carpet with negligible aspect crop.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished opaque color print texture for a rectangular carpet in a cozy cleaning game, exactly 1024 x 1280 pixels, portrait 4:5.
Primary request: a bright, adorable original cartoon character illustration, readable when viewed on a carpet at an angle.
Style/medium: polished playful 2D cartoon art, bold clean curving outlines, broad saturated color shapes, gentle simple shading, charming expressive face, high quality children's illustration.
Composition/framing: one large full-body main character occupying about 65% of the canvas, a simple decorative environment filling the entire rectangle edge to edge. Keep ears, face, feet and tail comfortably inside the image with about 8% safe margin. The image itself is the design to print, not a picture of a carpet.
Constraints: genuinely original character design; no known franchise characters, no logos, no writing, no letters, no watermark, no product mockup, no photographed rug, no textile fibers or baked carpet texture, no fringe, no physical frame or empty white margins, no transparent areas. Use joyful saturated colors with clear separation between character and background.
Subject: a cheerful round orange baby fox with oversized fluffy cream-tipped tail and tiny paws, happily sitting among large stylized daisies. Backdrop: saturated aqua and turquoise meadow with a few warm yellow flowers, rounded leaves, simple sunny shapes. Warm orange fox contrasts strongly with the cool background; friendly open eyes and delighted smile.
